title: Excel: Beginner to Professional — final assessment blueprint
attempts: Platform-configured; do not imply unlimited or guaranteed attempts beyond actual platform settings.
audience: Learners who completed core modules and selected relevant advanced modules.
learning_outcomes: Create and maintain a well-structured workbook.
Build and validate formulas, lookups, date/text processing and summaries.
Clean and analyze data with tables, visualizations and supported analytics tools.
Choose version-appropriate automation, document assumptions and audit workbook quality.

topic_distribution.topic: Formulas, references, functions, errors and dates
Lookups, dynamic arrays, Tables and data validation
Charts, PivotTables, Power Query and Data Model
Finance, dashboard, accessibility, security, automation and governance

question_file_note: Protected file has 18 representative blueprint questions; actual learner-facing delivery must filter answer_key/explanation server-side.
remediation: Review the related lesson and complete the linked practice exercise for each missed topic. Specialized features require a version/edition availability check.
